profile.role_note: Sustain + universal Crit buffer; fits literally any team.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Pull whenever she's on banner — the game's best sustain and Crit buffer fits virtually any team; the safest support investment in the game.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Stellar Symphony (or Variation) + 5-piece Rejuvenating Glow in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Fallacy of No Return in the main slot. Aim for a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, HP% 1-costs, and 250% Energy Regen to unlock her full Crit buffs.

ranked_weapons.name: Stellar Symphony
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Huge Energy Regen substat, HP boost, Concerto Energy on Liberation, and team ATK on heal. Best in slot by far.

ranked_weapons.name: Variation
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star alternative; massive Energy Regen and Concerto Energy restore. Still excellent at S1.

ranked_weapons.name: Rectifier#25
ranked_weapons.note: Decent Energy Regen option, but no Concerto Energy.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% substat boosts healing; small Energy Regen passive. Free last-resort alternative: the 3-star Rectifier of Voyager.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Boosts her healing and grants the team 15% ATK for 30s on Outro. Moonlit Clouds is usually run on the other support instead.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Extra Energy Regen and a 22.5% ATK buff for the incoming Resonator; use if nobody else holds it.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus is standard; Crit DMG maximizes her guaranteed-Crit Intro nuke (Discernment).
Energy Regen until 250% total; Spectro DMG after the cap is met.
HP% on both; her kit scales with HP.

teams.name: Premium: Sigrika + Qiuyuan + Shorekeeper

members.name: Sigrika
members.note: Echo Skill hypercarry; runes and enhanced Heavy Attacks scale off Echo Skill DMG.

members.name: Qiuyuan
members.note: Echo Skill DMG amplifier; his Outro grants Sigrika a massive Echo Skill DMG boost.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Crit buffs, healing, and All-Type DMG amplification through Stellarealm.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens, building Resonance and Concerto Energy before deploying Stellarealm, then Outros into Qiuyuan. Qiuyuan runs his Intro combo, Echo Skill, and Liberation, then holds his Heavy Attack string and casts Resonance Skill before Outroing into Sigrika. Sigrika casts her Echo Skill, builds runes with Basic Attacks, and spends them on enhanced Heavy Attacks and her Liberation, then swaps back so Shorekeeper can detonate Stellarealm.

teams.name: Alternative: Jinhsi + Zhezhi + Shorekeeper

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: The burst carry; Zhezhi's coordinated attacks feed her Incandescence stacks.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Coordinated attacks and Resonance Skill DMG amplification via Outro.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Heals and hands out broad Crit and damage buffs; detonates Stellarealm with her enhanced Intro.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens to build Resonance Energy and deploy Stellarealm; Zhezhi builds Forte and Liberation, then Outro into Jinhsi's full burst combo. Shorekeeper detonates Stellarealm at the end of the rotation.

teams.name: Alternative: Augusta + Iuno + Shorekeeper

members.name: Augusta
members.note: Heavy-attack hypercarry that pauses time with her Liberation to maximize every buff.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Heavy Attack buffer and healer; builds Wan Light stacks for Augusta.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm buffs plus healing while barely needing field time.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm, Iuno runs her Lunar Cycle to build Wan Light stacks, then Augusta takes an extended on-field window: Prowess-enhanced Heavy Attacks, skill, Liberation, and the Forte plunge.

tier_badge.label: Meta-defining
tier_badge.note: Still the game's best sustain; Crit buffs that fit literally every team.

sequences.verdict: S0 is the complete premium support. S2 is the only dupe worth real money; everything after is whale comfort.

pull_path.why: Full Stellarealm buffs, healing, and Crit package at S0.
Outer Stellarealm grants the team +40% ATK — her biggest single upgrade.
+42% Intro multiplier and +500% Crit DMG on cast — personal burst for Shorekeeper mains.
